title: Returning-Customer Discount on Unrelated-Damage Work — Insurance Claim Repairs Customer Terms
content:
A returning customer takes a discount on the work amount of an unrelated-damage addition to an Insurance Claim Repairs repair order — the labor hours times the hourly rate — and on the work amount alone, never on any other part of the addition's price. Whether the customer is returning is read from the customer's coverages under Workmanship Warranties.

## Terms

1. A customer holding an active **Collision Lifetime Workmanship Warranty** issued fewer than **24 months** before today takes the returning-customer percentage of **5 percent**.
2. A customer holding an active Collision Lifetime Workmanship Warranty issued **24 months or more** before today, or holding an active **Glass Installation Lifetime Warranty**, takes the long-standing customer percentage of **2 percent**.
3. Any other customer takes no discount.

The months are whole calendar months from the warranty's issued date to today. Only an active warranty counts.

## Holdings and the percentage

| Active Collision Lifetime Workmanship Warranty | Its age in whole calendar months | Active Glass Installation Lifetime Warranty | Discount on the work amount |
|---|---|---|---|
| held | fewer than 24 | held or not | 5 percent |
| held | 24 or more | held or not | 2 percent |
| not held | — | held | 2 percent |
| not held | — | not held | none |

The terms are read in order: a customer who qualifies under term 1 takes 5 percent even when also holding a Glass Installation Lifetime Warranty.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical warranties)

- Collision Lifetime Workmanship Warranty issued 23 whole calendar months ago, active: 5 percent.
- The same warranty one calendar month later, at 24 whole months: 2 percent.
- A Collision Lifetime Workmanship Warranty that is no longer active, and no other warranty: no discount.

## Hypothetical amount

On a work amount of USD 520.00, a 5 percent discount is USD 26.00 and a 2 percent discount is USD 10.40.
